For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Gulnar Begum, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY  ORAL ORDER 3 22-05-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case (C.R.) No.151 of 2021 instituted under Sections 498A of the IPC lodged on 05.03.2021 by the Complainant Kumari Aprajita.

Issue notice to the opposite party no. 2 through both processes i.e. ordinary as well as registered cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within a period of one week after vacation,
failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.3145 of 2023(3) dt.22-05-2023 List this case after service of notice and/or appearance of the opposite party no. 2 whichever is earlier.
Till then no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Complaint Case (C.R.) No.151 of 2021.
